name: Vishwas Refoils & Consumer
summary: Vishwas Refoils & Consumer, a Rajkot business that started as a proprietorship in 1996 and was incorporated as a company in March 2023, buys refined edible oils and processes, packs and sells them under the "Vishwas" brand, and makes filtered mustard oil; Gujarat brought in 93.7% of FY26 revenue. Revenue jumped from ₹79.8 cr in FY24 to ₹310.3 cr in FY26 and profit after tax rose 84.7% to ₹5.06 cr in FY26, but the net margin is thin at 1.6% and operating cash flow was only ₹0.50 cr. The ₹25.78 cr issue is all fresh money, with ₹19.30 cr going to a new edible oil refining facility; debt to equity was 0.72 before the issue. At the upper band the post-issue P/E is about 17.0x, slightly above the 15.5x median of the two listed peers, and the price to book of about 2.1x is above theirs.

fh1.finding: Revenue from operations rose from ₹79.79 cr (FY24) to ₹310.26 cr (FY26), a CAGR of about 97.2%.

fh2.finding: Revenue grew every year: ₹79.79 cr, ₹237.29 cr, ₹310.26 cr (FY24–FY26).

fh3.finding: Debt to equity was 0.72 in FY26 (borrowings ₹10.79 cr).

fh4.finding: Borrowings rose about 27% (₹8.47 cr in FY24 to ₹10.79 cr in FY26) while revenue nearly quadrupled.

fh5.finding: Net worth rose from ₹3.87 cr (FY24) to ₹6.95 cr (FY25) and ₹15.04 cr (FY26); the source table lists the years in reverse, but ₹15.04 cr matches the ₹22.53 NAV per share.

fh6.finding: Operating cash flow was ₹0.50 cr in FY26, about 10% of the ₹5.06 cr profit, after negative flows in FY24 and FY25.

pr1.finding: Profit after tax grew 84.7% in FY26, from ₹2.74 cr to ₹5.06 cr.

pr2.finding: Net margin improved from 0.91% (FY24) to 1.15% (FY25) and 1.63% (FY26).

pr3.finding: Return on net worth was 45.91% in FY26, down from 50.49% in FY25, on a small equity base.

pr5.finding: Peer profit or EBITDA margins were not found in public sources.

va1.finding: Post-issue P/E of about 17.0x (₹85.94 cr market cap on 95,49,060 shares at ₹90 ÷ ₹5.06 cr FY26 PAT) vs a peer median of 15.5x (Kriti Nutrients 9.4x, M. K. Proteins 21.6x), about 10% above.

va2.finding: Post-issue price to book of about 2.1x (₹85.94 cr ÷ ₹40.82 cr, i.e. ₹15.04 cr FY26 net worth + ₹25.78 cr fresh issue) vs a peer median of about 1.65x derived from their P/E, EPS and NAV, about 27% above.

va3.finding: Post-issue market cap to FY26 revenue is about 0.28x (₹85.94 cr ÷ ₹310.26 cr), but peer market cap to sales figures were not found.

va4.finding: No details of share issues or transfers in the 12 months before the IPO were found in public sources.

pg1.finding: Promoters hold 59.05% after the issue, down from 84.34%.

pg2.finding: No information on pledged promoter shares was found.

pg3.finding: Related-party transaction figures were not found in public sources.

pg4.finding: No information on regulatory action against promoters or directors was found.

is1.finding: The entire ₹25.78 cr issue is a fresh issue of 28,64,000 shares; there is no offer for sale.

is2.finding: The ₹25.78 cr issue is about 30.0% of the ₹85.94 cr post-issue market cap.

is3.finding: No selling shareholders, because there is no offer for sale.

up1.finding: ₹19.30 cr, about 75% of the ₹25.78 cr issue, funds a new edible oil refining facility.

up2.finding: None of the issue goes to repaying debt; the only objects are the refining facility and general corporate purposes.

up3.finding: The amount for general corporate purposes was not stated in public sources.

up4.finding: No loan repayment is among the objects, so no proceeds repay promoters or group companies.

lg1.finding: Litigation amounts were not found in public sources.

lg2.finding: No information on criminal or regulatory cases was found.

lg3.finding: Contingent liabilities were not found in public sources.

rk1.finding: The top ten customers brought in 41.77% of FY26 revenue.

rk2.finding: Reliance on a few suppliers for oil, with no long-term contracts and no in-house crude refining, is called out as a risk; exact shares are not published.

rk3.finding: The business began in 1996 as a proprietorship (Vishwas Tea Co.) and moved into the company, incorporated in March 2023, in March 2024.

rk4.finding: Auditor remarks were not found in public sources.
